title: Consultancy services of comprehensive Architectural and Structural Design (2D, 3D plan and elevation) of 20-25m RCC Lighthouse Tower for proposed New Lighthouse at Biswanath Ghat, Assam
summary: Two-cover QCBS e-tender for architectural and structural design consultancy (2D/3D plans and elevations) of a 20-25 m RCC lighthouse tower for a proposed new lighthouse at Biswanath Ghat, Assam, under the Kolkata Directorate.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhawan, D-372/2 Taratala Road, Kolkata

sites.name: Biswanath Ghat, Biswanath, Assam, Pin-784176 (proposed new lighthouse)
sites.work: Architectural and structural design of 20-25 m RCC lighthouse tower

scope.item: Consultancy services of comprehensive architectural and structural design (2D, 3D plan and elevation) of 20-25 m RCC lighthouse tower

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR/bank guarantee of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata; valid 3 months from technical bid opening; original to reach office by 31/07/2025 15:00. Tender fee Nil. QCBS evaluation.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Registered office for architectural consultancy services in India for at least 5 years
Similar work for Central/State Government organizations in last 7 financial years: one >= 80%, two >= 50% or three >= 40% of estimated cost; values updated at 7% simple interest per annum
Similar works: architectural and structural consultancy for infrastructure development, tourism development, river bank area development or other development works, or multistoried buildings in India
Firm/designated architect registered with Council of Architecture
Staff: 1 senior architect (B.Arch, >= 5 years) and 2 junior architects (B.Arch, >= 2 years)/civil engineers (B.Tech)
Undertaking to sign MoU with a structural design firm, with designs proof-checked by reputed institute/research institution/government department, at agreement signing
Valid PAN and GST; notarized non-blacklisting affidavit (2025); unconditional price bid undertaking; ITRs 2021-22 to 2023-24; tender acceptance letter; documents per Section VI
specs: RCC lighthouse tower height 20-25 m; deliverables 2D and 3D plans and elevations
